title: The Part-Time Job Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Job listings with employer, location, requirements, and posting dates. The Part-Time Job Database lists part-time jobs suited to student schedules: employer, location, pay, hours, requirements, and posting dates, with filters for evening, weekend, and remote work. Listings are checked for legitimacy signals and scam warnings are attached where patterns appear. The Signature side adds schedule-compatibility checkers that test a job's hours against class times.
capabilities: List part-time jobs with pay, hours, and requirements
Filter by evening, weekend, and remote availability
Attach scam warnings where patterns appear
Check job hours against class schedules
Track posting dates and remove stale listings
